facts.value: Measures all three linear-column lengths and returns zero angles if any length is below FLOAT_MIN. Otherwise pitch comes from -m[2][0]/length0 with endpoint saturation or asin. The ordinary branch computes X from calcVal(m[2][2]/length2,m[2][1]/length1) and Z from calcVal(m[0][0],m[1][0]); the other branch computes X from calcVal(m[1][1],m[0][1]) and sets Z=0. calcVal(x,y) returns signed pi/2 based on y >= 0 when abs(x) <= FLOAT_MIN, including +pi/2 at (0,0), and otherwise calls atan2f(y,x). RObj expression callers convert returned radians to degrees.

facts.value: Computes the source upper-3x3 determinant; abs(det) < 1e-10f writes identity. Otherwise writes reciprocal-determinant-scaled cofactors, then translation rows. For src == dest, only the cofactor reads use the temporary copy. Translation expressions still read src directly; writing dest[0][3] precedes reads of src[0][3] for later rows, so in-place calls can consume already overwritten translation components.
